channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 35 new entries
item.description:
35 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, proteomics, histology / imaging-only, multi-omics, and 2 more.

STARIT
Converts imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data into image tensors for deep learning-based cell state analysis.

Serval
Modular framework for developing and benchmarking barcode decoding methods, including new CoSiD algorithm.

CellART
Combines deep learning and probabilistic modeling for cell segmentation and annotation across high-resolution ST platforms.

Benchmarking copy number alteration inference methods for spatial transcriptomics
Benchmarks nine copy-number-alteration inference methods across spatial transcriptomics datasets and cancer types.

STiLE
Automates tissue microarray core assignment from spatial transcriptomics cell centroid coordinates using clustering algorithms.

SCOTE
Computes scale-resolved spatial covariance tensors to unify comparison across spatial omics platforms and resolutions.

Navigating the rapidly evolving landscape of sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics technologies: a comprehensive multi-platform benchmark
Systematically benchmarks multiple sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics platforms for capture efficiency and spatial accuracy.

ALBIS
Statistical framework simulating 3D tissue to generate synthetic spatial transcriptomics data at multiple resolutions.

ST-DAI
Domain-adaptive neural network imputes sparse spatial sections for cost-efficient 3D transcriptomics reconstruction.

SVC
Vision Transformer model learns subcellular transcript localization, transferring to imputation, clustering and perturbation tasks.

CauSTI
Infers direction-specific cell-cell communication from spatial transcriptomics using a causal-prior-guided variational graph autoencoder.

EcoNet
Graph attention network modeling TME signaling ecosystems to predict immunotherapy response.

CellCom2
Web platform combining multiple algorithms and resources to predict and visualize ligand-receptor cell communication.

SMODER
RNA-anchored framework deconvolving cell types from spatial multi-omics co-profiling RNA with other modalities.

Correlating metabolites, lipids, and N-glycans in murine kidney microstructures via integrative mass spectrometry imaging
Multi-omic mass spectrometry imaging protocol co-registering metabolites, lipids and N-glycans in one tissue section.

STARgrid
Open-source pipeline converting Visium HD sequencing reads into spatial count matrices, replacing Space Ranger.

spatialMIFtools
R package separating proximity, neighborhood composition, and conditional coordination statistics in multiplexed tissue images.

SpaNorm
R package performing normalisation of spatial transcriptomics expression data.

CONCERT
Generative model predicting spatially resolved transcriptomic responses to perturbations.

STalign
Python tool aligning spatial transcriptomics datasets via diffeomorphic metric mapping (LDDMM).

virtues
Foundation model analyzing multiplexed tissue imaging across molecular, cellular and tissue scales for clinical tasks.

spora-io
Unified data loading and processing framework harmonizing spatial proteomics and histopathology imaging datasets.

AlphaFISH
Sequencing-free subcellular spatial profiling platform with transformer model linking host transcriptome and microbiome.

ASTRA
Pretrained model performs zero-shot super-resolution reconstruction of spatial transcriptomics across capture geometries.

VINTER
Vision-language model jointly reading histology, expression and neighborhood to annotate and interrogate tissue regions.

SpatialOmicsLab
Integrated environment and LLM-based AI co-scientist that assembles and runs spatial transcriptomics analysis workflows.

Point-Process Modelling of Cell-Type Interaction Structure in CosMx Glioma Data for Hypothesis-Driven Tumor Inference from scRNA-seq
Log-Gaussian Cox Process framework modeling cell-type spatial interactions to predict tumor-proximity phenotypes.

mzQC
JSON-based standard and toolset for reporting quality-control metrics across mass spectrometry workflows, including imaging.

STAVelo
Graph attention encoder-decoder infers spatially-aware RNA velocity from spatial transcriptomics data.

InSTability
Computes per-spot clustering instability scores across repeated spatial transcriptomics clustering runs.

GRASS-MIL
Graph multiple-instance learning framework that predicts phenotypes and decomposes predictions into signed neighborhood contributions.

stLearn
Machine learning pipeline combining morphology, expression and spatial location to analyse spatial transcriptomics data.

STAgent
Multimodal LLM agent enabling conversational deep research over spatial transcriptomics datasets.

Scicore-Omics
Tri-modal foundation model jointly embedding histology images, spatial transcriptomics and biological language.

Serval
Modular computational framework for decoding imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data.
